headline: Azurobe Waterwing Dance
title: Azurobe | Waterwing Dance Ride On Water | Palworld Guide
video_script: Cross the water in style with Azurobe. Its partner skill, Waterwing Dance, lets you ride it across water, and while mounted your attack type becomes Water with five to twenty percent more Attack. At base it is a top Watering worker at level four. Great for lakes and coasts. Do you ride Azurobe? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Five to twenty percent more Attack

description: Azurobe in Palworld 1.0: Waterwing Dance lets you ride across water with a Water attack boost, and it works Watering at level four.
